messages:
narah: quick feedback needed on the "first-run" overlay I'm about to ship. two variants in staging: a left rail checklist + main area with one featured sample, vs a full-screen card grid of samples. goals: low friction for new users, clear affordance for sandbox samples, keyboard-first accessibility, and concise microcopy.
diego: saw both. i prefer the left-rail checklist for clarity; less visual noise. but the featured sample card needs a clearer label that it's a demo sandbox. maybe add a subtle tag: [Sandbox].
ali: copy nit: current button reads 'Get started with sample' (long). alternatives: 'Try sample', 'Open sample', 'Explore demo'. 'Try sample' is short and low-commitment.
fran: accessibility notes: 1) ensure focus trap inside the overlay when open 2) keyboard nav for sample list (arrow keys for grid) 3) role="dialog" and aria-labelledby pointing to the heading 4) add aria-live region for any dynamic teaser text.
narah: good catches. for the featured sample card i'm thinking small pill text "Sandbox" + visually hidden note "This sample runs in an isolated workspace" for screen readers. diego — can you mock the pill to be 2px stroke, low-contrast fill?
diego: sure. quick css mock: ```css
.pill { border: 1px solid rgba(16,32,48,0.08); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; }
.card:focus { outline: 3px solid #0066FF; outline-offset: 3px; }
```
ali: keyboard behavior: when grid present, arrow keys should move focus in a spatial manner; Enter activates; Space toggles selection. on mobile, grid collapses to single column and we revert to tab order. ensure touch target >=44px.
fran: also check color contrast for the card label — needs to meet AA (4.5:1) for standard text or at least 3:1 if large. add this to PR checklist.
narah: UX question: persist last-used sample as a tiny chip in the header after first run? Pros: quick resuming. Cons: adds chrome. if we show it, allow dismiss and hide in preferences.
diego: +1 to single chip with dismiss. show only when project has state from sample to avoid noise.
ali: copy variants for the chip: 'Recent: Starter search' or simply 'Resume sample'. 'Resume sample' is clearer that it's returning to previous session.
fran: testing plan: i will run keyboard tests with NVDA and VoiceOver on staging, check focus visuals, aria-announcements on teaser expansion, and mobile tap sizes. add results as comments on the PR.
staging-bot: deploy: feature/first-run-overlay -> staging build 2026-03-23T16:17Z :rocket:
narah: thanks — next steps: diego adjust pill & contrast, ali finalize 'Try sample' CTA and chip copy, fran will do accessibility QA after deploy, i'll open the PR with screenshots and an a11y checklist (focus trap, nav, roles, contrast). tagging @ali for copy sign-off. :thumbsup:
